description:

  • Preferred start date: August 2026.

TransUnion is seeking Senior QA Testers to support application security remediation efforts across a portfolio of approximately 15-20 existing applications. These resources will validate code changes resulting from vulnerability remediation efforts and help expand existing automated testing coverage. The team will leverage current testing frameworks and automation assets rather than creating automation solutions from scratch.

Responsibilities

  • Perform API, functional, integration, and regression testing.

  • Extend and enhance existing automated test cases and scripts.

  • Support testing across front-end, API, and back-end components.

  • Execute test scripts within UFT and ALM Octane environments.

  • Review test results and identify defects.

  • Collaborate with developers and project teams during sprint activities.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and testing reviews.

  • Support ongoing improvements to automation coverage and QA processes.

  • Track and report testing metrics and quality indicators.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of QA testing experience in Java-based technology environments.

  • Experience with Micro Focus/OpenText UFT (Unified Functional Testing).

  • Experience with ALM Octane for test case management and execution.

  • Linux Bash scripting knowledge.

  • Experience performing API testing.

  • Strong ANSI SQL skills.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

  • Familiarity with QA metrics and KPIs including:

    • DER (Defect Escape Rate)

    • DDP (Defect Detection Percentage)

    • DCE (Defect Containment Effectiveness)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience expanding and maintaining automated test suites.

  • End-to-end test automation experience.

  • White-box testing experience.

  • Grey-box testing experience.

  • Experience validating application security remediations.

  • Familiarity with Java applications and enterprise web services.

Additional Context

  • Existing automation frameworks and test assets are already in place.

  • This role focuses primarily on extending existing test cases and automation scripts rather than building new frameworks from scratch.

  • Testing will include front-end, API, and application-level validation efforts.

Soft Skills

  • Ability to operate independently and manage testing activities with limited supervision.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and accuracy.

  • Comfortable working with distributed teams across Mexico and the U.S.

  • English and Spanish bilingual capabilities preferred.

Engagement Details

  • Duration: 9 months with strong likelihood of extension to 12 months.

  • Location: Remote within Mexico, preferably Mexico City area.

  • Limited onsite attendance may be required for sprint planning and project meetings.

  • Preferred start date: August 2026.

  • Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

Key selling point for candidates: This initiative is highly visible within TransUnion and focuses on securing and modernizing critical applications following a major acquisition. Consultants will work closely with development, QA, and InfoSec teams while gaining exposure to enterprise-scale application security remediation efforts.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend
description:
Cargo: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend
Local de atuação: Remoto
Horario de Trabalho: Horário Comercial
Idioma: Inglês Fluente


Muito obrigada pela ajuda!

Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend / Search Platform (Contrato Temporário – 6 meses)

Estamos buscando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar em uma equipe responsável pela infraestrutura e plataformas que suportam experiências de jogos em escala global, atendendo milhões de usuários. A posição faz parte do time de Integrated Content, focado em tecnologias de User-Generated Experiences (UGX) para enriquecimento e distribuição de conteúdo gerado pelos próprios jogadores.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver sistemas backend robustos, resilientes e de alta performance.
  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar soluções complexas ponta a ponta.
  • Implementar estratégias automatizadas de migração, backup e recuperação de dados.

  • Apoiar a evolução de ambientes em nuvem e processos de automação.

Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de serviços backend.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Scala, Java ou Python.
  • Experiência com serviços de alto tráfego e alto desempenho.
  • Conhecimento avançado em plataformas de busca, como OpenSearch ou Elasticsearch.
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS (EKS, OpenSearch, Terraform).
  • Vivência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento de linguagens de programação imperativas e funcionais.
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA, como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code ou similares.
  • Inglês fluente

Diferenciais
  • Experiência com Apache Flink ou outras plataformas de processamento de dados em streaming.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de migração de dados da AWS, como Glue, DataSync e DMS.

Perfil desejado
Profissional com forte experiência em backend, arquiteturas escaláveis, plataformas de busca e ambientes cloud, que goste de atuar com sistemas críticos, alta disponibilidade, automação e boas práticas de segurança. Experiência em AWS e tecnologias modernas de dados será altamente valorizada.

title: SBD-QUITO SUR
description:
Título del Puesto: Subdistribuidor Autoventa – Sector de Confites
Ubicación: Quito – Trabajo en Ruta
Tipo de Contrato: Prestación de Servicios Profesionales

Sobre el Puesto
Estamos en búsqueda de un Subdistribuidor Autoventa para una importante empresa del sector de confites. Este rol está orientado a profesionales con experiencia en ventas de cobertura, con capacidad para manejar rutas y generar una relación cercana con clientes minoristas. El cargo combina autonomía, resultados y trabajo en terreno, con una retribución basada en desempeño.

Responsabilidades
• Realizar cobertura y autoventa en canal tradicional, visitando clientes establecidos y abriendo nuevos puntos de venta
• Cumplir rutas asignadas y garantizar el abastecimiento de productos en los puntos de venta
• Gestionar pedidos, entrega de productos y cobranza directa
• Impulsar las ventas de productos de confitería, ofreciendo promociones y negociaciones efectivas
• Garantizar una excelente atención al cliente y reporte diario de actividades

Requisitos
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año en cargos similares de autoventa, preventa o distribución en canal tradicional
• Conocimiento del mercado minorista en Quito y zonas aledañas
• Capacidad de negociación, orientación al cumplimiento de objetivos y actitud proactiva
• Manejo de facturación, cobranzas y liquidación diaria

Cualificaciones Deseables
• Experiencia en distribución de productos de consumo masivo, preferiblemente confites, snacks o alimentos
• Buen manejo de rutas, geolocalización y seguimiento de clientes
• Alto compromiso, autonomía y capacidad de organización

Salario y Beneficios
• Ingreso por prestación de servicios profesionales
• Esquema de remuneración: Sueldo base + atractivas comisiones por cumplimiento y cobertura
• Posibilidad de crecimiento como microempresario dentro de la red de distribución

Quiénes Somos?
¡Talento donde lo necesitas, cuando lo necesitas!
SGF Global es un proveedor líder de soluciones especializadas de talento, dedicado a conectar profesionales altamente calificados con oportunidades en múltiples sectores. Ofrecemos soluciones de contratación temporal, permanente y por proyecto en áreas como tecnología, finanzas y contabilidad, ingeniería, marketing, servicios legales, soporte administrativo y al cliente, energía, petróleo y gas, telecomunicaciones, manufactura, aeroespacial, ciencias de la vida, minería y servicios públicos.
En SGF Global trabajamos para posicionarte en el mejor lugar para tener éxito. Te damos acceso a oportunidades de alto nivel, compensaciones competitivas, beneficios atractivos y capacitación gratuita en línea. Mantente al tanto de cada oportunidad, en todo momento, incluso desde tu celular.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Job Title: Full-Stack Developer: .NET - II

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated, fast-moving Full-Stack Developer to join a small team building an AI-enhanced worker portal. In this role, you will contribute to designing, developing, and delivering high-quality features using .NET and Angular, collaborating closely with analysts and UX researchers in an Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable backend services and APIs using .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API).
  • Build responsive, dynamic front-end interfaces using Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, Angular Material).
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities such as intelligent search, chatbots, and personalized content delivery into the portal.
  • Participate actively in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Work directly with the Business Analyst to clarify requirements and translate user stories into working software quickly.
  • Iterate rapidly on prototypes and feature builds based on usability feedback and stakeholder input.
  • Write and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and support UAT activities alongside the analyst.
  • Identify and resolve defects promptly, with a bias toward fast turnaround and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • 3 years of full-stack development experience with .NET 10 (ASP.NET Core, C#, Web API, Entity Framework, YARP, Microservices architecture).
  • Proficiency in Angular (v18, signal-based county management, standalone components, dynamic components, modern syntax practices), RxJS, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Relational database administration using Entity Framework.
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, Git, containerization).
  • Ability to work at a fast pace, context-switch efficiently, and deliver in short sprint cycles.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative, team-first mindset.
  • The ideal candidate must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science Engineering, Licenciatura, or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, obtained from an accredited college or university recognized by the corresponding national education authority.
